title: I Heard My Own Voice
topic: I recorded myself sleeping. I wanted to know what I said. The recorder was still. Until I heard my voice. Whispering my own name. I wasn't the one speaking. Want to hear the tape?

title: The Mirror from Oakridge Thrift
topic: I bought the mirror on March 14th at Oakridge Thrift for twelve dollars. The frame was carved with vines and small birds. It looked beautiful on my bathroom wall. Two nights later I noticed something odd. The reflection showed the shower curtain slightly open when I knew I had closed it. I checked the real curtain — it was exactly where I left it. title: Voicemail from a Buried Phone
topic: My phone buzzed with a voicemail notification. It was from my father. He died five days ago. I placed his old iPhone in his casket myself. It was buried with him, six feet under. The voicemail was only fourteen seconds long. His voice, shaky and unfamiliar, whispered a single sentence. "I'm in room 217 at the Marriott on Elm. Don't come alone." title: The Door That Wasn't There
topic: I moved into a basement apartment on Cherry Street in October 2024. Rent was six hundred fifty bucks a month. Too cheap, I thought, but I signed anyway. On my third night there, I noticed a narrow white door behind my bookshelf. It was about two feet wide. I'd never seen it before. I pulled the bookshelf aside the next morning.
